title: jam-sudo/ngspipeline pipeline parameters
description: Perturb-seq raw-read pipeline: FASTQ -> GEX/guide count matrices -> per-cell guide assignment -> ALIVE-ready h5ad

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Samplesheet CSV: sample_id,gex_r1,gex_r2,guide_r1,guide_r2,expected_cells (one Perturb-seq sample per row).
input.help_text: Columns: `sample_id` (no spaces), `gex_r1`/`gex_r2` (10x gene-expression library R1 = barcode+UMI, R2 = cDNA), `guide_r1`/`guide_r2` (sgRNA feature-barcode library R1 = barcode+UMI, R2 = protospacer read), `expected_cells` (positive integer). Relative paths are resolved against the samplesheet's directory.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

guides.help_text: One row per sgRNA. `protospacer` is the 20-nt targeting sequence as it appears in the guide read. `vector_id` (optional) groups sgRNAs that share a vector, e.g. dual-guide libraries (docs/decisions/008).

reference_options.title: Reference options
reference_options.description: Reference used for gene-expression quantification (kallisto|bustools). Give either a prebuilt kb index directory or a genome FASTA + GTF.

fasta.description: Genome FASTA (gzipped ok). Used with --gtf to build the kb index in-pipeline (KALLISTOBUSTOOLS_REF).

reference_index.description: Directory with a prebuilt kb index (*.idx) and t2g.txt. Skips KALLISTOBUSTOOLS_REF. Use for full human references where kb ref exceeds available memory (docs/decisions/002).

chemistry.description: 10x Genomics chemistry, as the kb technology string. Determines the cell-barcode whitelist and read layout. Must be set by the analyst from the dataset's protocol (docs/decisions/001).

kb_workflow.description: kb-python workflow for reference and counting.

guide_assignment_options.title: Guide assignment options
guide_assignment_options.description: How each GEX-called cell is assigned a guide vector from the guide-count matrix (bin/guide_assign.py).

assign_method.description: threshold: top-1 UMI >= min_umi and top-1/top-2 >= min_ratio -> single. mixture: per-vector Poisson/Gaussian mixture on log2 UMI (Replogle et al.), posterior > 0.5; single = exactly one vector.

min_umi.description: Minimum top-1 vector UMI count for a cell to be assigned (threshold method; fallback for unfittable vectors in mixture). Default 10 = above the 99th percentile of the top-1 vector UMI in empty droplets of the reference sample (docs/decisions/009).

min_ratio.description: Minimum top-1 / top-2 UMI ratio for a single assignment (threshold method). Default 3 (docs/decisions/009).

keep_nonsingle.description: Keep multi/unassigned cells in the ALIVE h5ad with gene set to their status (inspection only). Default: exclude them (docs/decisions/006).

pool_alive.description: Also write alive/pooled.h5ad containing every sample (GEM group) of the samplesheet, obs index <barcode>-<sample_id>; needs more than one sample and one shared reference index (docs/decisions/011).

cluster_cloud_options.title: Cluster / cloud execution options
cluster_cloud_options.description: Only used with -profile slurm (T-30) or awsbatch (T-31). Set by the human per site; nothing here has a default.

slurm_partition.description: SLURM partition (queue) for -profile slurm. Required with that profile.

slurm_account.description: SLURM --account, if the site requires one.

slurm_extra.description: Extra sbatch options appended to every job.

aws_queue.description: AWS Batch job queue for -profile awsbatch. Required with that profile.

aws_region.description: AWS region of the Batch queue and S3 bucket.

aws_cli.description: Path of the AWS CLI inside the Batch compute-environment AMI (docs/aws_setup.md).

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).
